passage.title: Reading Part 1 - Test 10
passage.text:
TEXT A - Smart Thermostat Quick Start Guide

Initial Setup: Before installation, ensure power to your heating system is turned off for safety. The device is compatible with most standard systems. Follow the color-coded wiring diagram for proper installation. The setup process is straightforward and takes approximately 30 minutes.

Operating Instructions: The touch screen is intuitive and responds to simple swipes. You can customize temperature schedules through the mobile app. The device will automatically adjust settings based on your preferences and occupancy patterns. Energy-saving mode is activated by default to help reduce utility costs.

TEXT B - Customer Service Response

From: TechCare Support Team
Subject: RE: Installation Issue

Dear Mr. Chen,

Thank you for contacting us regarding your installation difficulties. We apologize for any frustration this has caused. Based on your description, it appears the issue is with the C-wire connection, which is essential for proper operation.

We recommend scheduling a complimentary installation service with one of our certified technicians. This service is free for the first 30 days after purchase. Please visit our website to book an appointment at your convenience. Our team is committed to ensuring you have a positive experience with your new thermostat.
